test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The line graph given below shows India's total quantity of fuel imported (in million tonnes) (dotted line) and the total value of that fuel imported (in USD billion) (solid line) for the year 2004-2007. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e674b03fc886e91a63a3831256bee2c689843f37a219dff43c19514edd888828.png] 

What was the ratio of the quantity of fuel imported to the value of fuel imported in the year 2006?
solution:
**Given:**

Values of total quantity of fuel imported (in million tonnes) for the year 2004-2007 = 380, 280, 280, 350

Total value of that fuel imported (in USD billion) (solid line) for the year 2004-2007 = 450, 380, 350, 450

**Calculation:**

Quantity of fuel imported in 2006 = 280

Value of fuel imported in 2006 = 350

Ratio = 280 : 350

⇒ 4 : 5

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
